evidence: http://kygeonet.ky.gov/pva/barren/viewer.htm (404, listed as the Barren PVA map service)
https://kgs.uky.edu/kgsmap/kgsgeoportal/servicedescriptions.asp (lists the Barren PVA service only as that 404 viewer link)
https://kygisserver.ky.gov/arcgis/rest/services/WGS84WM_Services?f=sitemap (no Barren PVA parcel service; only Ky_PVA_Webster_Parcels_WGS84WM)
https://gis-bradd-ky.opendata.arcgis.com (BRADD open data API: no Barren County parcel datasets)
note: Barren County KY parcel polygons are not published as a queryable ArcGIS service or file. The state PVA service for Barren is a 404; the state server has no Barren parcel service (tried Ky_PVA_Barren_* name variants); the BRADD portal has no parcel layer; the county's only parcel viewer (qPublic) is blocked and exposes no service. Only commercial paid downloads (DynamoSpatial, Equator, Regrid, ReportAllUSA) were found, which do not count as county-published data.
